Shawn, everything on Shop···· has arrived. The NerdOctaxe came September 10, and Amazon Shipping delivered the Thor P2 on November 6 ((number hidden)).

The replacement power supply for the NerdOctaxe still hasn't been set up, and I'm sorry. You've been asking for weeks, and your tests showed the board is fine.

I've passed it to the team again with your test results, so it's a power supply only and nothing needs to come back. They're offline now and will pick it up Monday at 10am ET. The answer will come to this email.

That's all true, and no movement on the replacement power supply.  However, do you know what I have received from HeliumDeploy?  TWO emails asking how everything is with my order and to please leave a review.  Can you imagine what that review would say?

I can imagine, and you'd have every right to write it. I'm sorry. Those review emails go out on their own after a delivery shows up, so they had no idea your power supply is still outstanding. That makes them feel worse, not better.

You don't need to answer them. What matters is getting the power supply to you. It's in front of the team with your test results and photos, and I've marked that this is your third week asking. They'll pick it up Monday at 10am ET, and the answer will come to this email.
